🚀 domainsearcher-app | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: Helping entrepreneurs and startups find and objectively choose the most suitable domain name for their new venture.
✨ Key Features: • AI-powered domain name generation • Real-time domain availability checking • Multi-dimensional scoring (LEN, PRO, MEM, BRD, ZON, FIT) • Adjustable scoring weights
📖 Summary: DomainSearcher is a free, browser-based tool that helps users find and select the best domain name for their startup. It uses AI to generate domain name candidates based on a startup idea, checks their real-time availability across various TLDs, and scores them on multiple criteria like length, pronounceability, memorability, brandability, and fit with the app idea.
